title: Offer essential app functions through the Action button

statement.en: Offer a set of essential app functions through the Action button.
statement.ja: essentialなapp functionの集合をAction buttonから利用できるようにする。

conditions: A separate App Shortcut solely for opening the app is unnecessary because the system already provides one.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Action button experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるAction buttonの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。

title: Consider a secondary watchOS Action button function

statement.en: Consider a secondary watchOS Action button function that supports or advances the selected primary action.
statement.ja: 選択したprimary actionをsupportまたはadvanceするsecondary watchOS Action button functionを検討する。

conditions: For workouts or dives, keep a secondary function simple, intuitive, and easy to learn and remember.
exceptions: Consider carefully before offering more than one secondary function because it increases cognitive load.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Action button experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
